subject: Food Science
title: Bacteria, Yeast, and Mold
description: A quick win: understand Bacteria, Yeast, and Mold.

hook.text: A single gram of soil contains 40 million bacteria. Your food is covered in microbes before you even touch it.

buildup.text: Three types of microorganisms matter in food: bacteria, yeasts, and molds. Each behaves very differently.

discovery.text: Bacteria reproduce every 20 minutes under ideal conditions. One cell becomes a million in just seven hours.

twist.text: Most food microbes aren't dangerous. Only a tiny fraction—pathogens—cause illness. The rest are harmless or helpful.

climax.text: Yeast gives us bread and beer. Mold gives us blue cheese and penicillin. Microbes are food's best friend and worst enemy.

punchline.text: Microbes are everywhere in food. Most help. Some harm. All matter.

quiz.question: How fast can bacteria reproduce under ideal conditions?
